These ROI data were then used as multivariate features in a support-vector machine (SVM) learning-based patients vs control brain classification ( Wang et al., 2007a ; Zhang et al., 2014 ).
The imaging data of the testing subject was then input into the model to predict whether the subject was a patient or control.

Combining all three modalities yielded the highest classification accuracy than any other combination (84.6%), but tissue volume and CBF did not substantially add to the accuracy of BEN alone (79.5%).
39 leave-one-out cross-validations were used to verify the classification accuracy.
